title: The Smoove abandoned cart trigger for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.3.6 does not sanitise and escape…
description: The Smoove abandoned cart trigger for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 4.3.6 does not properly sanitise and escape abandoned-cart data submitted by visitors. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to perform stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks against administrators by injecting malicious scripts that are executed in the admin dashboard.
